title: ramen hot water pot
text: ramen hot water pot. I purchased two of these.  I use them to make hot water and ramen.  But you could heat any soup or stew.  The stays cools and is handy when eating to hold.  Mine came with grey silicone (or like) gaskets - I am assuming they are for storage?  I put them on the pot, then put the lid on upside down.  The gasket is too loose for the lid - so this is the only thing I can think of.  They also each came with a foam washer (on a plastic stick) But I wash mine in the dishwasher - so I guess you could use but I don't use them for dishes - too hard to keep sanitary.  It is worthy to note that the pots do NOT have a spout.  So, you eat right from this pot.  All in all I very happy with my purchase.  They arrived quickly (I have prime) and well packed with some other items I purchased.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
